title: Чистая линия · авторский комикс
description: Воздушный рисунок, точные контуры и деликатные детали.
prompt: Reinterpret the existing sketch as an elegant monochrome clear-line comics drawing. Retain the scene, framing, object count and spatial relationships. Resolve perspective and organic forms through delicate, continuous, highly intentional contours. Favor open white areas, subtle line-weight changes, sparse fine hatching and small clusters of precise material detail. Give the composition a spacious, lucid rhythm without making it sterile or mechanically traced. Keep tonal masses restrained and detail subordinate to the primary silhouettes. Do not replace the source with a science-fiction landscape or invent costumes, machinery or scenery unless already indicated.

reference_artists.name: Moebius / Jean Giraud
